accessInformation: This project was funded by (1) Strengthening environmental health capacity (EHC) to detect, prevent, and control environmental health hazards through data-driven, evidence-based approaches. Tennessee Department of Health (TDH), National Center for Environmental Health, Centers for Disease Control (prime), CDC-RFA-EH20-2025, (2) Environmental Health Services Support for Public Health Drinking Water Programs to Reduce Drinking Water Exposures. Tennessee Department of Health (TDH), CDC Safe Water for Community Health (prime), CDC-RFA-EH15-1507, (3) Vanderbilt University Interdisciplinary Discovery Grant, and the Tennessee Department of Environment and Conversation.
licenseInfo: These data should not be used as an endpoint for decision making at local scales for water system infrastructure. These datasets are generated at a coarse scale not intended to be interpreted at local scales. More detailed information at a local scale for water utility service should be obtained from the local service providers in that area.
